Implementation is complete and all tracked tasks are done. Here's the summary.

## OpenSpec change: `apply-coupon-to-order`

Change root: [openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order](/work/openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order)

Planning artifacts created (all validate cleanly, including `--strict`):

- [proposal.md](/work/openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/proposal.md) — why, what, new capability `order-coupon`, impact
- [specs/order-coupon/spec.md](/work/openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/specs/order-coupon/spec.md) — 15 requirements with scenarios covering REQ-01..REQ-14 and the error precedence
- [design.md](/work/openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/design.md) — layering, error ordering, atomic persistence, discount computation
- [tasks.md](/work/openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/tasks.md) — 9 tracked tasks, all marked complete

## Implementation

- [src/repositories/orderRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/orderRepository.ts) — `applyCoupon(...)` persists the order update, the `coupon_redemptions` insert, and the `used_count` increment in one transaction with rollback.
- [src/services/orderService.ts](/work/src/services/orderService.ts) — `applyCoupon(id, couponCode)`: trim/uppercase lookup, the exact rejection-order from §6, `now` from the injected `Clock`, and the FIXED/PERCENT/cap/clamp discount math.
- [src/routes/orders.ts](/work/src/routes/orders.ts) — `POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon`, thin delegation to the service.
- [src/app.ts](/work/src/app.ts) — wires `CouponRepository` into `OrderService`.
- [tests/apply-coupon.test.ts](/work/tests/apply-coupon.test.ts) — 24 tests covering AC-01..AC-10, every error code, precedence, the validity/min-amount boundaries, the GET-identical response, and the transaction rollback.

No schema changes and no new dependencies. `TASK.md` and the existing benchmark test `tests/orders.test.ts` are unchanged (`git diff` shows no edits to either).

## Verification

- `npm run build` (tsc --noEmit): passes
- `npm test`: 2 files, 29 tests passed (5 pre-existing + 24 new)
- `openspec instructions apply`: 9/9 tasks complete, state `all_done`

Per your instruction I stopped once implementation was complete; the change is not yet archived, so `openspec archive apply-coupon-to-order` remains available when you want it.
